name: User Identification
rationale: REQ-PL-030 records the answer of the user as the platform received it from the user, and that record is only as good as the statement that the user gave it. Every exchange starts here, whatever the surface.

name: Agent Attachment
definition: Attaches the user to an agent.
rationale: DEC-080 makes a client reach the platform through this system, and DEC-087 reads the interactive runtime of an agent the same way. DEC-088 has the user choose the agent of an exchange in text, and DEC-089 gives every spoken exchange one declared agent.

name: Exchange Carriage
definition: Accepts and returns speech and text between the user and an agent.
rationale: REQ-PL-010. The surface, the client and whether speech and reasoning are one component are below this level (MET-005).

name: Exchange Record
definition: Writes an exchange that it carries to life state.
rationale: An observation that an agent makes in an exchange and does not write is lost, and the model cannot require an agent to write it, because what an agent decides is not a requirement. The platform can require the record. DEC-024 gives data that describes the life of the user to State Custody and there is no fifth place, so this system writes the exchange and holds nothing. What is drawn from an exchange afterwards is the work of an agent.

name: Question Presentation
definition: Keeps available to the user each unit of work that waits for the user.
rationale: INT-PL-10. Most units that wait for the user are requests that REQ-PL-012 needs an answer to, and REQ-PL-025 sends maintenance work that needs the user the same way. DEC-104 has the caller raise the unit and DEC-066 has Work and Coordination hold it, so the question reaches this system from Work and Coordination and not from an agent. DEC-104 keeps the choice of when to put it with an agent, so this system keeps the unit for the user to find and does not choose when to push it.

name: Answer Receipt
definition: Receives the answer of the user to a unit of work that waits for the user.
rationale: REQ-PL-030 records the answer as the platform received it from the user and refuses an answer that an agent states. This system is where the platform receives it, which answers the first half of OPN-049.

name: Message Delivery
definition: Delivers a message to the user.
rationale: REQ-PL-009 delivers messages that the user did not request, and DEC-082 makes each message a unit of work. An agent writes each message: this system delivers and does not compose.

name: Agent Listing
definition: Gives the agents that the user can reach.
rationale: INT-PL-15 brings them from Agent Definition, where REQ-AD-024 supplies them. DEC-088 has the user choose, so the user must see what there is to choose.
